header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: !' — if he recites this Du'a, Allah Ta'ala grants him good in his calamity. And in exchange for the thing he lost, He gives him something better than it'. Hazrat Umm Salamah (RA) says: “When Hazrat Abu Salamah (RA) died, I made Du'a as the Prophet ﷺ had said. Allah Ta'ala gave me someone better than Abu Salamah; He made Rasulullah ﷺ my husband”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ (فِي رَجُلٍ غَضِبَ عَلَي رَجُلٍ آخَرَ) لَوْ قَالَ: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ذَهَبَ عَنْه مَا يَجِدُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه البخاري باب قصة ابليس وجنوده رقم:٣٢٨٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sulaiman ibn Surad (RA) says: Speaking about a person who had become angry with someone, the Prophet ﷺ said, “If he had said (أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ), his anger would have gone away”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ نَزَلَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ فَأَنْزَلَهَا بِالنَّاسِ لَمْ تُسَدَّ فَاقَتُهُ وَمَنْ نَزَلَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ فأَنْزَلَهَا بِاللهِ فَيُوشِكُ اللهُ لَهُ بِرِزْقٍ عَاجِلٍ أَوْ آجِلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث حسن صحيح غريب باب مَاجاء في الهم في الدنيا وحبها رقم:٢٣٢٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “If poverty comes upon a person and, to remove that poverty, he goes to people and begs, his poverty will not be removed. If he complains to Allah Ta'ala to remove it, Allah Ta'ala will soon, or a little later, make arrangements to remove his poverty”', Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
